criteria: omp_bridge/g3/bridge.ts tool schemas and descriptions for to_worker / to_manager (read them; the skill must match exactly)
the experiment marker contract for staged worker deliveries (response_contract: answer with the marker line only, no tools)
required_behavior: Create omp_bridge/skills/to-worker/SKILL.md (manager) and omp_bridge/skills/to-manager/SKILL.md (worker) in English, each about one page, in the OMP skill format (front matter name/description as OMP 18.4.5 expects; check how OMP discovers skills in customDirectories).

to-worker: how to hand work to the worker with to_worker (kind experiment vs work, message, spec fields, run:true for re-runs, follow-up with task_id, cancel); the worker does ONE task at a time - on worker_busy wait for the to_manager report or cancel; experiments run in the host terminal only when it is idle (held:host_terminal_busy otherwise); retry limit 3; never put environment variable values in messages/specs; no push/merge; report results to the user after checking the worker's report.

to-manager: staged deliveries with a response_contract -> answer with the marker line only, no tools; for work Tasks do the work inside the given paths with your own tools and report with to_manager (progress/done/blocked/answer/report, requires_code_change); answer questions with to_manager(kind answer, in_reply_to); do not operate the host terminal directly; stay inside the task's paths.

Role filtering: set ROLE_SKILL_PATTERNS (backend/launcher.py) so manager loads only to-worker and worker only to-manager; update the isolation check so these Workbench skills count as expected (not leaks) and any other skill is still a leak; make sure the wb home config's customDirectories points at omp_bridge/skills.
acceptance: tests in tests/backend (role filter, isolation expectations) red->green

a no-model live check (fake HOME/Workbench home, outbound blocked) that the manager OMP lists only to-worker and the worker only to-manager (get_available_commands or the skill listing RPC), isolation ok
run tests/backend, tests/bridge, tests/contracts (test_*.py, no pipe, venv)
rules: Use /tmp/cw02-g1-venv/bin/python, short unique TMPDIR removed afterwards; no model prompts; OMP only with the Workbench home or a fake HOME (never the real HOME, not even --version); never read/print/copy/hash credential contents or other processes' environ; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's processes or configs; no commits, no graphify update; zero residue. A parallel worker (U5) edits src/workbench/ui/product - do not touch it.
result_format: checks table first, status, skill texts summary, changed paths + sha256, residue. Korean, <=15 lines.
